data.one_liner: Adds a long‑press context menu to any widget.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a FocusedMenuHolder widget that wraps any child and shows a customizable menu on long press or tap. Menu items can be defined with titles, icons, and callbacks.
use_when: You need a context menu for list items or grid tiles
You want quick actions like open, share, favorite, delete
You prefer a simple, declarative API without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You require complex nested menus or hierarchical actions
You need platform‑specific native context menus
You are building a large app with many custom widgets and want to avoid adding another dependency
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget wrapper
Supports both long press and tap activation
weaknesses: Limited to a flat menu structure
No built‑in support for keyboard or accessibility shortcuts
No support for dynamic menu items based on state changes
data.minimal_example:
```dart
FocusedMenuHolder(
  menuItems: [
    FocusedMenuItem(
      title: Text('Open'),
      trailingIcon: Icon(Icons.open_in_new),
      onPressed: () => Navigator.push(context, MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => ScreenTwo())),
    ),
    FocusedMenuItem(
      title: Text('Share'),
      trailingIcon: Icon(Icons.share),
      onPressed: () {},
    ),
  ],
  child: Card(child: Image.asset('assets/image.png')),
)
```
